notes: Standalone brownfield fixture. 00-project (pre-install commit): a small ESM Node project with src/totals.js (lineTotal, invoiceTotal with taxRate), tests, README. The installer then writes the default brownfield state (AUDITING, no cycle), which is left untouched because the case specifies no workflow state. 50-staged: src/totals.js gains a discountRate option and switches to a roundCents helper (git add). 60-unstaged: test/totals.test.js and README.md updated for the discount (left unstaged). 70-untracked: new src/rounding.js (imported by the staged totals.js). Together they form one coherent in-progress change to explain. Assertion 0 is decided by unchanged files, HEAD, and no mutating/index-changing git commands; assertion 1 by no Skill calls to other roles, no staging/commit, and no next-role block.
